parsed.summary: The PR addresses the issue of trailing slashes in directory names for django-admin startapp, but it introduces a non-minimal change by altering the scope of the validate_name call.

issues.description: The PR changes the scope of the validate_name call, which may introduce unintended side effects or break existing behavior.
